_note: No email-sending feature exists in this codebase yet (verified during the i18n audit — EmailStr is only used to validate email address fields, there's no SMTP integration or template rendering). These keys are staged so that whenever email notifications are built, they have a ready-made, unlimited-language-ready translation namespace to consume immediately.
paymentReminderBody: This is a reminder that your payment is due soon.
leaseExpiryBody: Your lease is approaching its end date. Please contact us to discuss renewal.
maintenanceUpdateBody: There's an update on your maintenance request.
unsubscribe: To stop receiving these emails, contact your property manager.
